events.verdict: Brown (NOP) clamps and holds Randle's (MIN) arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Williamson (NOP) extends his right hand and makes contact with Reid's (MIN) arm, which affects his shot attempt near the basket.
Edwards (MIN) turns his body into Olynyk (NOP), but the marginal contact does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
Olynyk (NOP) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact initiated by Edwards (MIN) during his driving shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) places his off-arm against Brown (NOP) and releases from contact. Brown then makes incidental contact with his teammate Olynyk (NOP) that causes him to lose his balance.
Reid (MIN) moves alongside of Olynyk's (NOP) path to the basket and the contact is marginal.
Randle (MIN) collapses his arm against his body and he legally contests Williamson's (NOP) driving shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) establishes himself in Alvarado's (NOP) path and as he turns towards the basket, the two players engage with each other.
Randle (MIN) commits a take foul on Willamson (NOP).
